data.mechanism: Released GATOR2 suppresses GATOR1 - a double negative. Two brakes in series is why the sensors can flip mTORC1 on so sharply.
data.mechanism_beginner: GATOR2 shuts down GATOR1 – a brake acting on another brake. That double-negative is part of why the switch flips on so sharply, though exactly how isn't fully worked out yet.
data.boundary: The epistasis is solid. VAL2022 resolved GATOR2's architecture by cryo-EM - a 1.1 MDa cage - and mapped where the sensors dock, but exactly how GATOR2 suppresses GATOR1's GAP activity is still not settled.
data.note: Good candidate for a 'mechanism gap' flag - textbook arrow, thin mechanistic evidence.
